relationships.subject: SIRT6
relationships.evidence_quote: siRNA-SIRT6 treatment induced a significant reduction in bilateral paw withdrawal mechanical thresholds, indicating that SIRT6 down-regulation contributed to prediabetic neuropathic pain induced by HED

relationships.subject: HMGB1
relationships.evidence_quote: prediabetic neuropathic pain is caused by SIRT6 reduction through upregulating HMGB1-RAGE signaling at both peripheral and spinal levels

key_findings: SIRT6 is decreased in DRG and spinal dorsal horn of HED-induced prediabetic rats while NF-κB, IL-6 and IL-1β rise.
SIRT6 reduction drives prediabetic neuropathic pain via NF-κB disinhibition and HMGB1-RAGE signaling.
